title: private-deploy scratchpad - customer A VPC install
content:
Daily scratchpad: customer A VPC/on-prem weekend push
Owner: Riley Nguyen (eng-private-deployments)
Date: 2026-03-08

High-level status:
- Waiting for customer infra team to confirm NAT gateway and route table updates (blocked).
- Package built and smoke-tested (image version: rdw-private-2026.03.07-rc3).
- Installer runbook updated with k8s taint tolerations and storage notes.

Immediate TODOs:
- [ ] Confirm customer has opened outbound 443 to S3 endpoints for model artifact download. (waiting on ticket INF-1296)
- [ ] Validate static IPs for control-plane egress (need from infra contact: lena@customerA)
- [ ] Run dry install on staging (on-prem mimic) with current image rc3 and capture logs
- [ ] Add KMS key alias to installer and validate CMK policy with security team
- [ ] Update canary rollout policy to use fallback-model: small-quant-v1 for low-memory nodes

Notes / install steps (working draft):
1) Preflight checks (run locally from bastion):
   - Ensure connectivity to customer S3: curl -I https://s3.customerA.internal/healthcheck -v
   - Check DNS resolution for internal registry: dig registry.customerA.internal +short
   - Confirm node labels: kubectl get nodes --show-labels
   - Verify cgroup driver and kernel modules (k8s requirement): sudo grep cgroup /proc/filesystems

2) Image push and registry auth:
   - docker login registry.customerA.internal --username deploy-bot --password-file ~/.registry/deploy-bot-token
   - docker tag rdw-private-2026.03.07-rc3 registry.customerA.internal/rdw/private:2026.03.07-rc3
   - docker push registry.customerA.internal/rdw/private:2026.03.07-rc3
   - NOTE: customer registry requires cert bundle at /etc/ssl/certs/customer-root.pem on every node (add to runbook)

3) Helm install (helm v3.11 assumed):
   - helm repo add rdw https://charts.redwood.ai
   - helm upgrade --install rdw-private rdw/rdw-private --namespace redwood --create-namespace \
       --set image.tag=2026.03.07-rc3 \
       --set config.kms.keyAlias=alias/rdw-customerA \
       --set networking.egress.staticIPs={10.0.8.12} \
       --set storage.pvc.storageClass=fast-ssd \
       --wait --timeout 10m
   - If pvc pending: check storage provisioner logs and node taints/tolerations

4) Post-install validation:
   - kubectl get pods -n redwood -l app=rdw-private -o wide
   - curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://rdw-private.customerA.internal/health | jq .
   - Run sample inference request with small model and verify latency < 150ms first token
   - Confirm logs rotate and are forwarded to customer ELK (log-forwarder configured)

Known blockers / customer environment quirks:
- Customer uses a transparent proxy for outbound traffic which strips custom headers; installer fallback needs to avoid signed custom header for S3 presigned downloads.
- KMS policy: customer CMK requires principal ARN mapping; our installer currently assumes KMS key accessible to the deploy service account. Need explicit IAM binding step documented.
- On-prem nodes have older kernel (5.4) — our cuda driver installer fails on 5.4 on some machines. Workaround: pre-install driver from vendor repo and use --skip-driver flag in installer.
- Customer ops requested no public IPs on nodes; need to ensure bastion has NAT and correct security group rules for outbound updates.

Debug hints / quick commands:
- Tail installer logs: kubectl -n redwood logs deploy/rdw-installer -f --since=1h
- Check for imagePullBackOff reasons: kubectl describe pod <pod> -n redwood
- Validate KMS access from pod: kubectl exec -it <pod> -n redwood -- curl -sS http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/info || echo 'no-metadata'

Follow-ups / questions for customer ops:
- Can they provide a temporary NAT IP for the control-plane egress so we can complete initial model pulls?
- Will they allow S3 endpoint white-listing instead of opening 443 outbound?
- Who is the owner for registry cert distribution? (cc: lena@customerA)

Meeting notes (03/08):
- Miguel confirmed we have updated RBAC roles for deployer account. Still need CMK binding step.
- Samira will push a small script to copy the customer cert bundle to /etc/ssl/certs during preflight (PR created).

Next steps for me today:
- Run staging dry install and capture install logs, attach to INF-1289
- Update runbook section "Network requirements" with explicit list of firewall rules and sample iptables commands
- Draft message to customer ops requesting NAT IP + registry cert owner

Misc scratch notes:
- Keep an eye on memory/cpu reservations in values.yaml: default reservations are 4g/2cpu which might be too high for customer small nodes
- Consider adding a lightweight fallback model (quant 4-bit) for very constrained deployments

End of scratchpad.
